description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging utility that wraps Android's native Log class, allowing it to be part of a chain of log nodes for flexible log handling within the application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility within the Logger interface, enabling multi-target logging and chaining.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain where log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message and optional exception to Android's log system and forwards the log to the next node if present.
